Normal CBC/iron studies, TSH/free T4, CK, BMP and pregnancy test make anemia, hypothyroidism, primary myopathy, metabolic causes, and pregnancy-related causes unlikely. Central causes or primary fatigue syndromes typically cause perceived fatigue without true weakness on self-care tasks. Therefore the single most likely diagnosis is generalized autoimmune myasthenia gravis.
